tasks.name: Protests — Activatica pilot (243 items)
tasks.description: 243 Activatica posts classified by Haiku v2.2 (173 protest=TRUE, 70 FALSE). Verify the protest/not-protest call + protest_type + regime_crit. This is the audit-blocking validation before the full ~12K Activatica re-classify ships. Stable input — won't be invalidated by the in-flight master reboot.

tasks.name: rusSocial responsibility — focused 20-post verify
tasks.description: 20 posts with Haiku's blame-attribution predictions shown for verification. ~15 min target. Strata: direct+attr=True, related+attr=True, tangential+attr=True, direct+attr=False, comment_inherited, unrelated_random. Outputs go to rusSocial/data/processed/responsibility/validation/. Unblocks the full responsibility classifier per 2026-05-07 audit.

tasks.name: rusSocial responsibility — blind 81-post label
tasks.description: 81 posts, Haiku predictions hidden — blind labeling for unbiased κ scoring against the gold standard. Same 6-field codebook as the focused task. ~2 hours at 1-2 min/post.

tasks.name: rusSocial sentiment — 5-model 200-post comparison

tasks.name: Disaster — Sample E (200 events, active learning)
tasks.description: Active-learning chunk built 2026-05-12 from disasters_master_v3 + Layer 2 LLM filter + severity_recal + dates_consolidated. Strata: 40 disasters_strict random, 30 standard\strict random, 20 validated_only random, 30 severity_recal=HIGH, 20 severity_recal=MEDIUM+deaths_lower>=1, 20 Layer2=NO+corroboration>=3 (FN hunt), 20 Layer2=BORDERLINE stratified by type, 20 day-precision dates (5 ea Wikidata/EM-DAT/Telegram-strict-high/medium). Excludes 213 already-labeled eventids.
